verdict.rationale: Pipedream MCP is documented as an MCP server that other apps and agents connect to ('Point any MCP client at Pipedream's remote server'). The evidence never shows the product acting as an MCP client that can plug in external MCP servers and use their tools. Its own server endpoints and managed-auth tooling are a different role and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
